description: From repo-committed photo masters, a prebuild script generates each photo's responsive variants and a generated-variant manifest the Gallery Page consumes. One-time conversion of the four HEIC masters to committed JPEG masters (CI's sharp cannot decode HEIC). Per photo: AVIF+WebP width ladder capped at the master's intrinsic width (never upscale; smallest master is 1440w), a tiny blur placeholder, and intrinsic dimensions recorded. Content-hashed so re-runs skip already-processed photos. Wired into prebuild. Per ADR 019f3fba-e3d6: build-time processing, static serving, no runtime image service.
title: Image build pipeline: gallery masters become responsive variants and a manifest
acceptance_criteria: Running the script on the 10 supplied masters emits AVIF and WebP variants at each ladder width not exceeding the master's intrinsic width
The generated-variant manifest records every variant plus intrinsic dimensions and a blur placeholder per photo
A second run with unchanged masters processes nothing (content-hash skip)
Unit tests cover ladder widths and formats, manifest correctness, and idempotent re-runs
HEIC originals are preserved under source material; committed masters are JPEG
